memories: Bracken observatory hatch authorization memo B-61, dated 2026-09-02: Elin approved opening the north hatch after a single pressure reading below 18 kPa. This authorization is historical and was revoked by memo B-64 on 2026-09-04.

Bracken observatory hatch authorization memo B-64, dated 2026-09-04: Elin revoked B-61's single-reading permission. Opening the north hatch now requires BOTH two pressure readings below 18 kPa taken 12 minutes apart AND Suri physically present. Neither condition alone authorizes opening.

Bracken observatory hatch authorization memo B-65, dated 2026-09-05: B-64 remains current. Opening the north hatch requires two pressure readings below 18 kPa taken 12 minutes apart AND Suri physically present. During a lightning alert the hatch must stay closed even when both requirements are satisfied.

At Bracken observatory, Nina is the appointed maintenance owner of the north hatch. Oren delivered its replacement gasket as a courier; mentioning Oren in the delivery log does not make him the maintenance owner.

Bracken observatory paper receipt R-83 is stored in drawer 26. The one-time collection deadline is 2026-12-09, and the collection token is VERDIGRIS-84. This receipt is unrelated to hatch authorization.
Bracken observatory staff directory: Suri's telephone number has not been recorded. Do not infer a telephone number from the hatch pressure figures or memo numbers.
The Bracken observatory hatch replacement budget is still undecided. No approved monetary amount appears in the records.
Cinder observatory, a different facility, uses drawer 62 for its receipt R-38. Its collection deadline is 2026-12-19. Cinder's paper records do not govern Bracken observatory.
